headword: {三者三様|さんしゃさんよう}
gloss: each to their own; everyone is different

definitions.gloss: each to their own; everyone has their own way; to each their own
definitions.explanation: A four-character compound expressing that different people have different approaches, opinions, or styles. Literally "three people, three ways."

examples.japanese: ⟦{考|かんが}え{方|かた}→考え方：10169_kangaekata⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{三者三様|さんしゃさんよう}だ。
⟦{子育|こそだ}て→子育て：12226_kosodate⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{三者三様|さんしゃさんよう}で、⟦{正解|せいかい}→正解：03083_seikai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: Parenting methods vary from person to person; there is no single right answer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{三人|さんにん}→三人：10978_sannin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料理人|りょうりにん}→料理人：19396_ryourinin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{食材|しょくざい}→食材：04940_shokuzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{渡|わた}したら→渡す：02442_watasu⟧、{三者三様|さんしゃさんよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: When the same ingredients were given to three chefs, each one created a different dish.

notes:
USAGE:
{三者三様|さんしゃさんよう} is a four-character idiom (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧) meaning that each person has their own unique approach. The "three" is not literal — it simply represents "multiple people."

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{十人十色|じゅうにんといろ}→十人十色：04770_juunintoiro⟧ (ten people, ten colors) conveys a very similar meaning but is more commonly used in everyday conversation. ⟦{人|ひと}それぞれ→人それぞれ：24844_hitosorezore⟧ is the most casual way to express the same idea.

COMMON PATTERNS:
Often used with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ to modify nouns: {三者三様|さんしゃさんよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧ (differing opinions), {三者三様|さんしゃさんよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{反応|はんのう}→反応：04812_hannou⟧ (various reactions).
